title: OpenAI’s new ChatGPT feature logs your keystrokes and stores them in plain text
summary: OpenAI has launched Computer History, a ChatGPT feature that records clicks, keystrokes, keyboard shortcuts and app switches on macOS to build a searchable memory. The feature is unavailable in the European Economic Area, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.
